name: Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder
source:
In 2364, the wounds of World War III are healed… but they left some ugly scars. In the Rome area (or what’s left of it), radiation still kills slowly and silently.
It’s the place Min-Joon Watal - an extremely wealthy philanthropist and heir to the Watal Industries empire – chose to build an underground sanctuary city: Tosca, sheltered from those deadly radioactive waves that poison the Lazio region. But what Watal didn’t see coming is the locals’ resistance to his project: they don’t trust this man who comes from the “Colonies”, these artificial satellites where the rich and famous took refuge, far from the Earth and its agony, its filth, its brutality. Conspiracy theories run wild about Tosca, civilian militias are formed to attack its construction site.

In order to defend his utopia, Watal assembles a dream team of “Harcos” pilots, capable of maneuvering these giant combat robots. The operation is led by Galanos, a veteran who’s as taciturn as he is talented ; Oli, the reserved negotiation expert ; Joa, the medic with a slight paranoia problem, and his wife, Chrys, a bit rough around the edges… and really rough with her enemies ; and RoKo, the Artificial Intelligence who supports them and tries to make them laugh with his corny jokes, alongside his sensitive creator, Thomas, whose innocent and charming smile could melt an iceberg if there were any left.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2259230/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
2364年，第三次世界大戰的傷口已經癒合，卻留下了幾道猙獰的疤痕。羅馬一帶（或者說，羅馬僅存的那部分地方），輻射依然在悄無聲息中慢慢奪走人命。
億萬富豪、慈善家兼瓦塔爾工業帝國的繼承人民俊．瓦塔爾，正是看中了這裡，決定建起一座名為托斯卡的地下避難城，讓人們躲過荼毒拉齊奧地區的致命輻射。他沒料到，當地人竟會抵制這個專案。他們不相信這個來自「殖民地」的人。那些所謂的殖民地，是富豪和名流為躲避地球的苦難、骯髒與暴虐而逃往的人造衛星。關於托斯卡的陰謀論四處流傳，民兵甚至結隊襲擊工地。

為了捍衛自己的理想之城，瓦塔爾召集了一支「哈爾科斯」王牌駕駛員隊伍，操縱巨型戰鬥機器人。隊長加拉諾斯是一名寡言而身手不凡的老兵。奧利性格內斂，擅長談判。軍醫喬亞有點疑神疑鬼，他的妻子克里斯說話做事有些粗魯，對付敵人時可遠不止「有些」。人工智慧RoKo在旁支援，愛講土味笑話逗大家樂；它那心思細膩的創造者托馬斯則有一副天真迷人的笑容，世上要是還剩冰山，見了也得融化。
